description: The contract exposes the company to uncapped damages or excludes liability caps for broad categories of claims without negotiated limits.
The indemnity obligation is one-sided, covers indirect losses, or applies to claims outside the company's control.
The agreement involves personal data but does not define processing purpose, security obligations, subprocessor controls, deletion or return, audit support, or breach notification.
The contract lacks a specific security incident notification deadline or allows delayed notice after confirmed impact only.
The agreement renews automatically without a practical reminder window, termination right, or notice period aligned to business requirements.
